prompt: A horizontal digital illustration in a gritty, caricature style depicting a group of five boisterous fishermen entering a pub. The scene is split into two sections: the left side features the artwork, and the right side is a black panel containing text. In the artwork, five men with exaggerated, drunken expressions and red noses are bursting through a doorway. They wear heavy blue knit sweaters, yellow raincoats, and fisherman's hats. One man in the center holds a dark bottle, while another to his right holds a metal tankard. Seated at a wooden table in the foreground are two other men looking up at the newcomers; one on the left has a large nose and holds a glass of beer, while the man on the right is balding and wearing a blue coat. The background shows a dimly lit pub interior with hanging lanterns and framed signs on the walls reading 'THE DRIFTING COD' and 'RUM GIN BITTERS & BAD LANGUAGE'. On the right side, against a solid black background, white serif text displays a haiku: 'the shrimpers / stinking of shrimp and brine / enter the pub / already drunk on bitters / boisterous as stuck pigs'. Below the poem is smaller credit text: 'AI image created by Michael H. Lester in collaboration with GPT Image 2 Low on @Nightcafestudio twitter: ™mhlester', followed by two URLs. A QR code sits in the top right corner.

promptZh: 这是一幅横向的数字插画，采用粗犷的漫画风格，描绘了一群喧闹的渔民进入酒馆的场景。画面分为两部分：左侧是艺术作品，右侧是一个包含文字的黑色面板。在艺术作品中，五名表情夸张、满脸通红且醉意盎然的男子正破门而入。他们身穿厚重的蓝色针织毛衣、黄色雨衣和渔夫帽。中间的一名男子手持深色酒瓶，而他右侧的另一人则拿着一个金属酒杯。前景中，两名男子坐在木桌旁抬头看着新来者；左边那位鼻子很大，手里拿着一杯啤酒，右边那位秃顶，穿着蓝色外套。背景展示了灯光昏暗的酒馆内部，挂着灯笼，墙上的框牌写着“THE DRIFTING COD”和“RUM GIN BITTERS & BAD LANGUAGE”。在右侧纯黑背景上，白色衬线字体展示了一首俳句：“the shrimpers / stinking of shrimp and brine / enter the pub / already drunk on bitters / boisterous as stuck pigs”。诗歌下方是较小的署名文字：“AI image created by Michael H. Lester in collaboration with GPT Image 2 Low on @Nightcafestudio twitter: ™mhlester”，随后是两个 URL。右上角有一个二维码。
